subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw publish a provider/model-family/capability compatibility matrix with formal lifecycle statuses and deprecation windows, and what guarantee should each status imply?
rationale: The remaining work is public support policy and metadata ownership, not a narrow implementation defect; automation cannot choose the support guarantees for official versus community providers.

options.title: Approve lifecycle registry
options.body: Create a canonical lifecycle metadata contract with generated docs and CLI visibility while keeping live probes separate.

options.title: Limit to live diagnostics
options.body: Defer static support guarantees and focus on narrower health checks such as #63145 for configured models.

options.title: Defer to provider/plugin docs
options.body: Keep lifecycle status owned by provider/plugin documentation without adding a core matrix.

recommendation.title: Approve lifecycle registry
recommendation.body: Create a canonical lifecycle metadata contract with generated docs and CLI visibility while keeping live probes separate.
